history.name: The date it was presented
history.description: A release carries the date it was actually shown, which appears on the edition's front page, in its running footer, and as the point the next edition measures "since last time" from. Today's date is assumed when none is given, and a baseline can be dated back to when the work really started.
history.dev_notes: --date YYYY-MM-DD, validated by pattern; longDate() formats it without dragging the machine's timezone into a date that has none.
